records.header_literal: A) NKJ, UKS v LP (12.51 p.m., November 16th); FUER UKS 0900 (16), 2 TEILE; 1 TL RICHI-212
records.readable_german: An OKM. Sofortige Bestaetigung erforderlich, ob Funkspruch 1XAXC?XR vom 1RX11 betr. Waffenstillstandsbedingungen
records.meaning: Immediate confirmation is requested that a telegram on armistice conditions has arrived. The reference and date labels remain unresolved; the sentence continues in A2.

records.title: Maintain nightly radio reception for the link to Germany
source_rows: --VFG FAXFV AAAVA GFXVX XFVXG FAXFX FAXXX DDAAF
XDXAD AXAXX FAFVA DAAXV VVFDF XXVAG VXXVD AAGAA
FDFAX GAFGG DXXDF AXXXD DVADF AADFA VXXGF VFVGG
VVGFA VAXXG VG
records.readable_german: Stehet jede Nacht auf Empfang. Verbindung mit Deutschl. dringend benoetigt.
records.meaning: Maintain reception every night; a connection with Germany is urgently needed. Only the source-labelled second part is present in this record.
notes: The printed 2 TL is retained. The absent first part is not reconstructed from this second part.
Two opening dashes are source-mask slots. The unchanged Nov13–15b key produces this body despite the printed 16 November date; this is a documented key-use observation, not a silent redating.

records.readable_german: KM Abt. Nachrichtenmittel erbittet Nachricht ueber Verbleib Hptm. v. Borries, Gen. Kdo. ?2.
records.meaning: The War Ministry communications-equipment section asks for information on the whereabouts of Captain von Borries. The general-command label ?2 is not numbered historically.
notes: The OCR omitted the final four-coordinate group GVFD. The source visibly prints it, and restoring it yields the exact advertised 164-slot frame. This is a transcription correction, not a historical coordinate insertion.
The body names VXBORRIES; no specific person is identified from the surname alone.

records.header_literal: C) KOW v WAU (1.50 a.m., November 18th); 0115 (17), 2 TLE; 1 TL RICHI-244
records.readable_german: GE?NACH2O2. Leichte in Lomza und Czenstochau, Verbleib unbekannt. Vermutl. mit ihren Gouvs. aberueckt. Besatzg beiden anderen Stat. ohne Geraet.
records.meaning: The whereabouts of the light units or equipment in Lomza and Czenstochau are unknown; they are presumed to have departed with their governors. The crews of the other two stations have no equipment. The opening is opaque and several transmitted abbreviations and the missing-letter spelling ABERUECKT remain visible.
notes: The source prints four dash slots: XD--- and GG-AX. The opening GE?NACH2O2 remains unresolved.
The source-length output ABERUECKT is not silently expanded to [abgerueckt]. VERMUTL, GOUVS, BESATZG and STAT remain their transmitted abbreviated forms.

Part 2 advertises 282 slots but the reviewed page prints 242. A 40-slot tail-loss hypothesis yields related fragments, but is not accepted as a complete source-length decipherment or counted as another reviewed reading here.

records.title: Numbered reply with PSO BSL and WAU signature
source_rows: DAXGD AAFXF XVDFD AGVAG AXGXX FXXAX DFDFX DVFFF
VAXAX VDDVV FVDGF XFXFX FXFFF GFVXV XFGDG ADAAA
AXGF
records.readable_german: Zu 2??F vom 1?X: 1. Nein. 2. PSO BSL. Fusta WAU.
records.meaning: A short numbered reply answers no to item 1 and gives the literal call-sign-like pair PSO BSL for item 2. The inquiry number, date and expansion of PSO remain unresolved.
notes: The source visibly prints VAXAX and the final AXGF, both omitted from the earlier OCR candidate. The native count is 84.
The transmitted fragment 1?XX is shown as 1?X before the sentence separator; no value is supplied for its unresolved cell.

prior_credit: Published period keys: George Lasry, Ingo Niebel, Nils Kopal and Arno Wacker (2016), and George Lasry (2017 key list). Earlier unreviewed repository candidates are preserved separately. This is a source edition and explicit repair review, not a claim of universal first-decipherment priority.
limits: All catalogued records use native source slots in printed order; no insertion, deletion or reordering.
Digits and rare-letter labels remain literal. An unfilled published square cell remains globally shared and injective.
Global full witnesses complete unknown key cells injectively and fill any residual source masks only to demonstrate consistency; they are not historical readings.
